verdict: Not complete yet, close. The trace exists and the check is green on both branches (1202 ids, 0 uncited, 0 dangling, 0 duplicates; every non-refuted verdict of verify-1..5 is cited by a synth2 output; after triage every one of the 349 spec edits landed). Six Required defects remain, each small: the plan says the coverage half of tools/ci reqs is T104's while the branch holds it in T121's commit (an owns overlap T104/T105 and an empty checks line follow); T122's commit edits .github/ask-first.yaml, CODEOWNERS and the generated ask-first page outside its owns and without an ask-first approval line; four 12 12.9 rows marked [review] carry ids against 12 12.11; five obligations built by M3 and M4 tasks (REQ-0929, 0932, 0933, 0934 of 10 10.3; REQ-0727 of 09) are cited only by deferred M6 tasks; two unordered owns overlaps (T035/T054 on setup/steps.go, T021/T051 on 03-formats.md); and reqs allocate can reuse a retired id when a retired row does not parse. Plus the duplicated list numbers in docs/plan.md.

findings.proposed_change: In reqsAllocate, after `pages, err := reqPagesAt(root)`: `live, findings := reqIDs(pages); retired, more := reqRetired(pages); if f := append(findings, more...); len(f) > 0 { return false, fmt.Errorf("%s; nothing was written", lines(f)) }` (a placeholder is a finding of reqIDs, so filter the placeholder finding out, or run the check on the live ids and the retired table only). findings.defect: Small code points: `reqTasksIn` returns a `[]finding` that is always nil, and `reqsOf` appends it; in `reqIDs` the `first` of `reqRetiredRows` is shadowed by `first, dup := live[m.body]`; `reqConsistency` sorts map keys through a hand-written iterator where `slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(retired))` reads plainer; `reqLines` folds CR LF to LF and allocate writes LF back, so a CR LF page is silently rewritten.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader looks for the finding `reqTasksIn` could return and finds none; a CR LF page diffs whole on its first allocate.
findings.proposed_change: Drop the second return of `reqTasksIn` and the `taskFindings` line of `reqsOf`; rename the retired range to `rowFirst, rowLast`; use `slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(...))` in `reqConsistency` and `reqCoverage`; say in `reqsAllocate`'s doc comment that a page is written with LF line ends (or keep the original ending).
findings.evidence: tools/ci/reqs.go:379 'func reqTasksIn(files []treeFile) ([]reqTask, []finding, error)' returning 'tasks, nil, nil'; :195 'first, last := reqRetiredRows(p)' and :208 'if first, dup := live[m.body]; dup'; :167-169 'reqLines splits content into lines, with CR LF read as LF'.
